meta.note: Public channels only. Verified roles list an official source and as-of date; seats we could not verify are marked source pending or Not yet covered. No response-time estimates: a response time appears only where an official published service standard exists.

heads.method: Candidates from Wikidata (P35, P6, P39 with start date, office P856). A seat goes live only when the candidate is the latest current holder on Wikidata AND the name appears on an official government page fetched on the checked date. Start dates show only when the year (or full date) appears next to the name on that page.
